categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Longda Superalloy Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-temperature superalloys and alloy materials. Its main product lines include cast high-temperature superalloys, wrought high-temperature superalloys, nickel-based corrosion-resistant alloys, and alloy tubing products such as copper-nickel alloy tubes and high-speed rail grounding alloy tubes. These products serve strategic industries including aerospace, energy power, oil and petrochemical, shipbuilding, automotive, and rail transit.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced metallurgical technologies including vacuum induction melting, electroslag remelting, vacuum consumable electrode remelting, and multi-stage homogenization treatments. It has mastered the triple melting process combining vacuum induction, electroslag, and vacuum consumable electrode remelting for wrought superalloys, enabling production of large ingots with high purity and uniform composition. The firm also employs precise chemical composition control, fine-grain forging, and rapid element detection technologies. It has established a standardized testing system certified by CNAS and NADCAP, covering over 70 elements in superalloys.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in aerospace (including military and civil aircraft engines), gas turbines, oil and petrochemical equipment manufacturers, shipbuilding, automotive turbochargers, and rail transit sectors. The company supplies critical components for advanced domestic and international aerospace engine manufacturers such as Rolls-Royce, Safran, and Collins Aerospace. It also serves major domestic enterprises in energy, petrochemical, and transportation industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province. It has expanded its international presence with subsidiaries and production bases established in Singapore and Malaysia to support global market penetration. Overseas sales have grown significantly, with international revenue increasing by over 159% in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Longda operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, producing high-performance alloy materials and semi-finished products that serve as critical raw materials for downstream manufacturers of aerospace engines, gas turbines, and other high-end equipment. It also engages in alloy tube manufacturing for various industrial applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation as its core growth driver, investing heavily in R&D with a focus on developing new superalloy grades, improving purity and uniformity, and advancing recycling technologies for returned materials. It collaborates with national laboratories and universities, operates a postdoctoral research station, and participates in multiple national and provincial scientific projects. Future R&D priorities include low-rhenium single-crystal superalloys, thin-walled complex forged components, and cost-effective manufacturing processes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of alloy products and materials to industrial customers, including long-term supply agreements with major aerospace and energy companies. The company employs a sales model combining direct sales and distributor channels, with sales recognized upon transfer of control to customers, typically at delivery or upon customs clearance for exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangsu Longda is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer of both cast and wrought aerospace-grade superalloys, holding a prominent position in China's strategic materials sector. It competes with other domestic and international superalloy producers by leveraging advanced proprietary technologies, comprehensive quality certifications, and close integration with the domestic aerospace and energy supply chains. The company is recognized as a national 'specialized and innovative' enterprise and a key participant in major national aerospace projects.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.39 billion, a 15.22% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 66.1 million, up 19.38%. Total assets grew by 6.33% to RMB 3.57 billion. The company has demonstrated steady growth driven by expanding sales in aerospace and gas turbine sectors, with significant international revenue growth. R&D investment accounted for 4.28% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Longda emphasizes its high-purity, low-defect, and compositionally uniform superalloys tailored for critical aerospace and energy applications. Its proprietary triple melting technology and advanced testing capabilities ensure superior material performance and reliability. The company offers comprehensive product certification and quality assurance aligned with stringent aerospace standards, enabling it to serve both domestic and international high-end markets with products that support strategic national industries and reduce reliance on imports.
